title: Build script does not run TypeScript type checking
reasoning: The project depends on TypeScript, but the release build is configured as only `vite build`. Vite transpiles TypeScript and does not perform full semantic type checking, so type errors can reach production bundles unless a separate `tsc --noEmit` step is run in CI or before release. The scripts section also has no dedicated typecheck command to make that quality gate explicit.
recommendation: Add a `typecheck` script such as `tsc --noEmit`, and make `build` or the release/CI workflow run it before `vite build`, for example `"build": "tsc --noEmit && vite build"`.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The listed test scripts run Vitest suites, which can pass while unrelated TypeScript semantic errors remain in application code. No included script provides a typecheck gate.
suggestedRegressionTest: Run `npm run build` or CI against a deliberate TypeScript-only error and verify the command fails before bundling.
minimumFixScope: Update `package.json` scripts to add and invoke a TypeScript typecheck step.
